services.name: Culinary Pedigree
services.desc: With a fresh, clean scent of lavender emanating from the plants of the same name, planted at the entrance of our grounds, as a backdrop, the culinary approach at French Creek is truly one of garden-to-table distinction. Known for our weekly Chef's Features presentation, we pride ourselves on delivering a second-to-none dining experience for our Members and their Guests. The French Creek Grille Room is an exceptional dining destination for our Members and their Guests. Our seasonal menus offer a variety of dishes with a farm to table focus.
